description: Screen-record the phone for a few seconds (real frames, ~6-12 fps): optionally navigate first, scroll smoothly, or tap an element mid-way. The clip plays in the video as a live recording.

liveLoad.description: record the page opening (default true when route is given)

route.description: page to open; the opening (loading, entrance animations) is recorded live

scroll.description: scroll smoothly while recording (true, or distance in dp)

scrollFrom.description: when scrolling starts, as a fraction of the recording (default 0.5 with route: hold while the page loads)

tap.description: visible text of an element to tap mid-recording

tapAt.description: second at which to tap (default: halfway)

name: video_record
